استوزرت (form X)
# اِسْتَوْزَرْتُ (istawzartu) /is.taw.zar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# اِسْتَوْزَرْتَ (istawzarta) /is.taw.zar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# اِسْتَوْزَرْتِ (istawzarti) /is.taw.zar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# اِسْتَوْزَرَتْ (istawzarat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
